ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide]:
# Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide

ACEVA Technology designs, engineers, and deploys custom software solutions tailored to specific industry workflows. Below is the comprehensive guide for major project types, detailing what ACEVA builds, key features, technical architecture, and business outcomes.

---

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [1. Restaurant, Food Service & Cloud Kitchen Systems]:
## 1. Restaurant, Food Service & Cloud Kitchen Systems

metadata.title: Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide
metadata.heading: 1. Restaurant, Food Service & Cloud Kitchen Systems

chunks.content:
ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [What ACEVA Builds]:
### What ACEVA Builds
Custom digital ordering portals, mobile customer apps, table booking engines, kitchen display systems (KDS), and inventory management platforms for restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, and franchises.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Key Features]:
### Key Features
- **Online Menu & Direct Ordering**: High-resolution food catalog with customization options (addons, spice levels, dietary tags) and instant checkout.
- **Table Reservation & Booking**: Real-time table selection, slot availability, and instant SMS/Email booking confirmations.
- **Kitchen Display System (KDS)**: Tablet-optimized live screen for kitchen staff to receive, track, and update order statuses in real time.
- **POS & Payment Gateway Integration**: Accepts credit cards, mobile wallets, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cash on delivery with automated sales reporting.
- **Customer Loyalty Program**: Points, discounts, digital coupons, and repeat customer retention analytics.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Technical & Business Benefits]:
### Technical & Business Benefits
- **Technical**: Built with Next.js, real-time WebSocket/SSE order updates, PostgreSQL database, and Stripe payment gateway.
- **Business**: Eliminates 15-30% third-party food app commission fees, increases direct customer retention, and reduces order entry errors.

---

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [2. E-Commerce Platforms & Retail Management]:
## 2. E-Commerce Platforms & Retail Management

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [What ACEVA Builds]:
### What ACEVA Builds
Custom e-commerce platforms, multi-vendor marketplaces, inventory control systems, point-of-sale (POS) synchronization, and customer account portals for retail brands and wholesalers.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Key Features]:
### Key Features
- **Product Catalog & Search**: Instant multi-attribute filtering (category, size, color, price, availability) and search autocomplete.
- **Cart & Secure Checkout**: High-converting cart with discount codes, guest checkout, tax calculation, and multi-currency support.
- **Inventory & Order Management**: Real-time stock level synchronization across online stores and physical retail locations.
- **Shipment & Delivery Tracking**: Automated tracking links sent to customers via email/SMS with courier integration.
- **Admin Analytics Dashboard**: Sales performance, top-selling items, customer lifetime value, and revenue reports.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Technical & Business Benefits]:
### Technical & Business Benefits
- **Technical**: Headless architecture using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, and Stripe/PayPal integrations.
- **Business**: Ultra-fast page load speeds increase conversion rates, while automated inventory prevents overselling.

---

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [3. Healthcare, Clinics & Telehealth Platforms]:
## 3. Healthcare, Clinics & Telehealth Platforms

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [What ACEVA Builds]:
### What ACEVA Builds
Patient portals, doctor appointment scheduling platforms, telehealth video consultation systems, electronic medical record (EMR) integrations, and clinic administrative dashboards.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Key Features]:
### Key Features
- **Doctor Profiles & Appointment Booking**: Browse doctors by specialty, view availability slots, and book appointments online.
- **Patient Portal**: Secure access to medical history, lab test reports, digital prescriptions, and doctor notes.
- **Telehealth Video Consultations**: Web-based video calling for virtual doctor appointments without installing extra software.
- **Automated Appointment Reminders**: Reduces no-shows via automated SMS and email reminders.
- **Billing & Insurance Tracking**: Patient invoice generation, payment processing, and claim record tracking.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Technical & Business Benefits]:
### Technical & Business Benefits
- **Technical**: Encrypted data transmission (TLS 1.3), secure authentication, WebRTC video streaming, and encrypted database backups.
- **Business**: Streamlines clinic scheduling, improves patient satisfaction, and reduces staff administrative workload.

---

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [4. Real Estate, Construction & Property Management]:
## 4. Real Estate, Construction & Property Management

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [What ACEVA Builds]:
### What ACEVA Builds
Property listing portals, virtual tour showcases, tenant portals, construction job tracking systems, maintenance work order dispatching, and landlord dashboards.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Key Features]:
### Key Features
- **Interactive Property Search**: Filter listings by location, price, property type, bedrooms, amenities, and map view.
- **Tenant & Rent Portal**: Online rent payments, digital lease agreement sign-offs, and maintenance request tickets.
- **Job & Site Inspection Tracking**: Construction milestone tracking, worker daily logs, material inventory, and photo reports.
- **Document Repository**: Secure file storage for blueprints, permits, contracts, and inspection certificates.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Technical & Business Benefits]:
### Technical & Business Benefits
- **Technical**: Cloud blob storage for high-res property photos/videos, dynamic map rendering, and role-based admin permissions.
- **Business**: Accelerates property lease-up rates, automates rent collection, and improves project timeline visibility.

---

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [5. Logistics, Transport & Supply Chain Platforms]:
## 5. Logistics, Transport & Supply Chain Platforms

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [What ACEVA Builds]:
### What ACEVA Builds
Fleet management dashboards, dispatch control towers, driver mobile apps, warehouse management systems (WMS), and shipment tracking portals.

- **Dispatch Control Tower**: Real-time overview of active shipments, driver assignments, route statuses, and delay alerts.
- **Driver Mobile App**: Turn-by-turn route view, job acceptance, customer contact, and electronic proof of delivery (e-signature & photo).
- **Client Tracking Portal**: Public or authenticated shipment tracking link showing live delivery milestones.

ACEVA Technology — Comprehensive Industry Project & Solution Guide [Technical & Business Benefits]:
### Technical & Business Benefits
- **Technical**: Real-time event streaming, mobile PWA capabilities, offline data sync, and role-based security access.

ACEVA Technology — How ACEVA Can Help You [How ACEVA Can Help You]:
# How ACEVA Can Help You

ACEVA Technology is a custom software company that builds digital products and platforms for businesses across every industry. If you have a business problem, ACEVA can design, build, and launch the technology to solve it.

ACEVA Technology — How ACEVA Can Help You [Building New Products and Platforms]:
## Building New Products and Platforms

If you need a new website, web application, mobile app, internal tool, dashboard, e-commerce platform, booking system, customer portal, or any custom software — ACEVA can design, build, and launch it for you. ACEVA works with businesses of all sizes — from startups launching their first product to established companies modernizing their operations.

ACEVA does not use generic templates. Every project is scoped, designed, and built specifically for the client's business needs. The result is software that fits how you actually work.

ACEVA Technology — How ACEVA Can Help You [Improving Existing Systems]:
## Improving Existing Systems

If you already have a website, application, or software that needs improvement — ACEVA can assess it, modernize it, fix bugs, improve performance, redesign the user experience, or rebuild parts of it. ACEVA's Product Rescue service is specifically designed for projects that are stuck, broken, underperforming, or abandoned by a previous development team.

Whether it is a slow website, an app that crashes, a system with security issues, or software that no longer meets your needs — ACEVA can evaluate it and provide an honest recommendation for what to keep, what to fix, and what to rebuild.

---

# Product Rescue & Reliability

Product Rescue & Reliability is for unfinished, unstable, difficult-to-scale, insecure, delayed, or inherited software. ACEVA audits first rather than recommending a rebuild by reflex.

ACEVA Technology — Product Rescue & Reliability [Includes]:
## Includes

- Code and architecture audit
- Bug stabilization and performance work
- AI-generated code review
- Security and deployment assessment
- Testing, documentation, and a modernization roadmap

The assessment identifies risks by severity and separates what can be kept from what should be replaced. A sample Rescue Report is described as containing findings, severity, what to keep, what to replace, and a 30/60/90-day plan.

ACEVA does not promise every product can be repaired and does not quote a rescue project before senior review.

ACEVA Technology — Proof Sprint [Proof Sprint]:
# Proof Sprint

A Proof Sprint is a short paid engagement that solves or demonstrates one narrow part of a problem and hands over a roadmap. It lets a prospective client assess how ACEVA works and whether the plan holds up against real code before committing a larger budget.

For new products, a Proof Sprint may establish scope, a prototype, and a build plan. For operations improvement, it may demonstrate one controlled automation with human approval and activity logging.

### Next.js & React
- **Technical Explanation**: Next.js is a full-stack React framework utilizing Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration. It provides automatic code splitting, optimized image assets, Turbopack bundling, and optimized routing.
- **Non-Technical Explanation**: Next.js ensures your website or web application loads instantly, ranks high on Google search (SEO), and delivers a smooth, fast experience on both mobile phones and desktop computers.

ACEVA Technology — ACEVA Technology Stack and Architecture Guide [TypeScript]:
### TypeScript
- **Technical Explanation**: TypeScript is a strongly typed superset of JavaScript that enforces static type checking at compile time, eliminating runtime type errors, NullPointerExceptions, and payload mismatches.
- **Non-Technical Explanation**: TypeScript acts like an automatic safety check while building your application. It catches bugs and mistakes before your software is launched, preventing crashes and security flaws.

- **Non-Technical Explanation**: Your website or application will look beautiful and function perfectly on iPhones, Android phones, tablets, laptops, and large monitors, while remaining easy to use for all visitors including people with disabilities.

## Honest Claims & Standards
- ACEVA does not claim that its 5 capability pillars are unique inventions. Global consultancies sell custom software, AI, mobile products, and cloud modernization. 
- AI-assisted coding is becoming normal — ACEVA's competitive advantage lies in the senior code review process, architecture, security, and transparent client experience around it.
- The goal is not to invent a new category, but to package familiar software capabilities in a clearer, faster, and more trustworthy way.

## Client Feedback and Testimonials Policy
- **Zero Incomplete or Invented Feedback**: ACEVA has no fake or unverified testimonials and strictly refuses to write its own or publish composite/anonymous quotes.
- **Written Permission Required**: Future client feedback will be published only with explicit written permission, attributed with named person, role, and company.
- **Source-Verified Metrics**: Performance metrics and numbers are published only when supported by the client's own verified reporting.
- **Demonstrable Proof**: Visitors are invited to judge ACEVA on live, demonstrable work — including the ACEVA platform itself, interactive automation demos, concept dashboards, and sample Rescue Reports.

## Concept Demos and Live Experiments
ACEVA showcases concept demos and internal product frameworks (honestly labeled as concept demos rather than client projects):
- **Digital Experiences Demo**: The official ACEVA website itself, built with product-grade design, adaptive visitor paths, mobile menu/CTA bars, and WCAG AA accessibility.
- **Operations Dashboard Demo ("Freightline Ops")**: Concept demo showcasing role-based permissions, locked actions, real-time KPI metrics (Open Jobs, On Time %, Overdue, Dwell Time), task queues, and manager reporting.
- **Mobile Product Demo**: 4-step mobile field-work app journey showcasing passwordless 6-digit code verification, route view, next-action callouts, and proof-of-delivery closeout.
- **Intelligence & Automation Demo**: Interactive workflow automation demo featuring Human-in-the-Loop decision gates (AI proposes actions, a named human approves).
- **Sample Product Rescue Report**: Sample deliverable showing findings by severity (Critical, High, Medium), action recommendations (what to keep, what to replace), and a 30/60/90-day stabilization plan.
